page.layout: One printed page, no columns. Digitiser's cover sheet: e-rara logo at top right, title block centred, a grey rule, a block of licence and usage notices below, and a Visual Library logo at the foot. All of it is digitiser material and is left out.
page.notes: The page is the digitiser's cover sheet for e-rara (Universitätsbibliothek Bern), not a printed page of the book. Its title block reads: "Explicationes systematis theologici Dn. Wollebii, in disputationes distinctae", by Albinus, David, [Bernae], 1677. The logo, persistent link and licence notices are left out as digitiser material.
